Definition: A legal, operational, customer, vendor, partner, internal, or third-party organization represented in ITOMS.
A human being tracked independently of any single login, employer, company relationship, or account.
A contextual communication or relationship role held by a Person for another object or purpose.
A physical or logical place where people, assets, services, or data can exist.
A tracked item of operational, technical, financial, compliance, or custodial value.
A technical Asset with computing, networking, communications, security, or embedded functionality.
A Device delivering shared compute, storage, identity, application, network, or infrastructure services.
A software product, service, workload, SaaS application, executable, or service principal used by a Company.
A recurring entitlement, service plan, license agreement, cloud subscription, or contractual right to use a service.
A collection used to grant, deny, scope, classify, or review access to systems and data.
A formal or operational statement of expected behavior, configuration, responsibility, or control.
A measurable safeguard or practice used to reduce risk or satisfy a framework requirement.
A documented exposure, uncertainty, weakness, or condition that may negatively affect business objectives.
A low-friction factual note about something seen, heard, measured, discovered, or suspected that may deserve later review.
A structured evaluation that answers one or more Questions using current evidence, object state, and defined criteria.
A defined sequence of states, activities, approvals, automation, verification, and outcomes associated with an object or business process.
A signal indicating something currently deserves human attention and explaining why.
An enduring business or technical subject that can accumulate cases, observations, evidence, decisions, risks, and projects over time.
A specific instance, investigation, question, incident, decision thread, or problem within a Topic.
A captured artifact, measurement, assertion, screenshot, log, document, API result, approval, photo, or other support for a finding or decision.
